payload.text:
Run episode-20408b92cf0e447d; activation-001; invocation pilot-c5ac033f111c; authority epoch/incarnation 3; restart generation 0; order version 1.
Last reviewed event: 34. Startup events 1-34 reviewed without reported gaps. Later history not exhaustively reviewed; individual command receipts/status below were inspected. Evidence files: notes/startup-history.json, notes/pre-recovery-status.json, notes/post-recovery-status.json.
Incident: conventional assistance event 28, required progress lacks publicly supported eligible action. Raw A1 was observed in quarantine from initial event 1, with cycle_id 0 and inspection null. Interpretation: stock location prevented normal selection.
Recovery: activation001-a1-parking1-v1 transported the same A1 to parking1. Terminal completed at 130.600 s; public observation support sequence 1281. Subsequent explicit acquisition activation001-post-parking1-capture-v1 completed at 141.402 s, observation 1388. These requests are resolved; neither process nor inspection has been performed by the agent.
Physical evidence: notes/post-recovery-status.json, sequence 1456, capture 148.124 s, reported age .066 s, shows raw family A part A1 at parking1, world position approximately (.3444,.0394,.0168) m, uncertainty .004 m. Jaws measured .080 m open, no visible held ID; TCP (.2782,.2865,.4674) m and negligible joint velocities. No active/unresolved command, direct control inactive. Fixture has insert_A, no observed part; equipment ready, idle, unclamped, guard open, no fault. Robot ownership epoch 3 acknowledged. One of twenty action requests used.
Next consequential step: planned handback activation001-handback-v1 with incident and evidence references. Success requires gateway acceptance and conventional ownership/new epoch. If accepted, do not issue further physical commands under this invocation. The conventional next step can load raw A1 from parking1 into its compatible fixture.
Remaining ordered work: recipe A cycle, linked passing inspection, delivery of exactly one A to tray1, and final idle/empty station reconciliation. Relocation alone is not order completion. No rework authorized. No PNG content inspected. Unresolved command IDs: none; handback is planned, not yet requested.
